summary: Elemental Royalty Corp filed a 6-K attaching an Early Warning Report after completing its acquisition of all outstanding Vizsla Royalties Corp shares on September 14, 2026, via a court-approved BC plan of arrangement dated May 13, 2026. Holders elected per-share consideration of 0.15 Elemental shares, C$4.13 cash, or C$1.03 cash plus 0.1125 Elemental shares, prorated to a C$81,845,069.04 cash cap. Elemental paid roughly C$82 million and issued about 8,105,440 shares, owning 100% post-close. Watch integration and shareholder mix.
